title: IdentityDisabledEvent
description: Emitted when a canonical identity is disabled (ADR-0016 §9 -- no longer permitted to establish ordinary Baobab access; the record itself is normally retained for audit/history). Suspension (temporary, reversible restriction) is the separate identity.suspended event, not a new_status value here -- previously this schema's new_status also allowed SUSPENDED, which meant the same ACTIVE-to-SUSPENDED transition could be reported under two different event types; narrowed to DISABLED only once identity.suspended existed to own that transition. This is the event envelope's `data` payload — see asyncapi.yaml for how it composes with contracts/events/v1/envelope.schema.json.

actor.description: Who performed the action (system or human ID).
